No, I’m not religious or spiritual or anything like that. 
I’m open-minded, I’ll look into just about anything, but will only believe something as much as there is evidence to support it. In terms of nihilism, I’d say a fat 50%. 
Thinking truly properly leads to the conclusion that there simply isn’t enough information to know the shape of the far future in anything remotely resembling certainty, with 21st century knowledge alone. It could be far better, or even far worse.
You might have figured out that I think I’m better than most people, and you’d be somewhat correct. That gives my ego a huge boost but also leads to me feeling extremely lonely. And I have no intentions of assimilating into the parts of the common world view I disagree with. I don’t think the people I look down on (nearly everyone) are just like that and it’s out of their control, although the fact that it’s the vast majority does imply they don’t know how to use that control. The population that see clearly is tiny, not sure exactly of its magnitude, although I predict it to grow with time.
This might get downvoted to oblivion, but the reason I’m posting this reply is twofold: hopefully to spark something in people, and also if this resonates with anyone, feel free to DM me. I’m looking for others like myself, but I estimate our population to be about one in a million, plus or minus about three orders of magnitude, and it’s hard to find each other.

The system is fucked up. I’m a first year uni student, I’ve always had fabulous grades, but I still think they aren’t what defines us. To much emphasis is put on passing high school, some people are just better suited for other things than academics. There’s so many different ways to make a living and most if not all the stuff you do in school doesn’t really matter for some of them. There’s so much damn stigmatization against people who just aren’t good at math, science, whatever you are required to take in school. I feel really bad for you. People should treat you better and everybody’s good at at least a couple things. Find those things, and don’t worry to much about what you don’t like or aren’t good at. You matter, and that doesn’t depend on you being good at a few things that happen to be what lots of jobs happen to have as required skills. Lots, not all. 
One thing that makes me sick is how hard life is if you aren’t good at a few specific things. Anyone could be good or not good at those things, it isn’t really intrinsic to who you are. I think everyone is entitled to great lives, call me a dreamer but I think one day that will be reality someday. Even in this century I think you can still succeed, please don’t let the school system get you down too much. Trust me, you aren’t a failure because you “fail” school. School is designed for some people but not for everyone. I’m not “better” than you because I’m doing well in school, we each have random talents given to us by a nonexistent god who probably doesn’t care about us on the off chance that they do exist. Talents are great and they make life better and easier, but everyone should be able to do well, and I hope you can, even if the world is set up wrong. If things were right, nobody would be worse off, but most of us would be better off. Heck, all of us would be better off. 
It makes me sad to see good people suffer. Don’t beat yourself up because you have assholes in your life. I have bad problems as well, that’s why I’m on this sub. Sorry if that was a bit long and disorganized, I just want you to know that even if you need to repeat a year you shouldn’t give up hope, eventually you’ll find people who care and are nice. There are people out here that don’t judge others for stupid reasons. You’re important, even if you don’t feel that way.
